newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei to build shopping complex in Okinawa.
newsitem.headline: Daiei to build shopping complex in Okinawa.

text.p: Daiei Inc said on Friday it won a contract to redevelop 214 hectares of land on the southern island of Okinawa into a shopping and entertainment complex.
Daiei, Japan's largest supermarket chain operator, expects to complete the project, which will also include a 320-room hotel and a cinema complex, in October 2000, a company spokesman said.
Annual sales from the new complex, to be located north of the Okinawa capital of Naha, are targetted at about 35 billion yen, he said.
The spokesman declined to reveal how much Daiei would invest in the project.
The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday that total investment in the project is estimated to reach 20 to 30 billion yen.
The land Daiei will redevelop was formerly used as a housing complex for the U.S. military.
